reproducibility: Self-report generation is batched, so an item's output depends on which items share its batch. Rerunning with this read_batch and the concept ordering in items.jsonl reproduces the file exactly. The collapse is an LLM call at temperature 0 and is not bit-reproducible; collapsed_jlens_l12.jsonl is the artifact of record for it.
lens_budget: J-lens top-50 collapsed to its first 10 distinct concepts (GLM-5.2 merge of spelling-level variants, then mechanical un-merge of non-variants); see collapse.py
